solution.title: Active Directory RID & Group-Provisioning Capacity Assessment

products.name: Active Directory RID & Group-Provisioning Capacity Assessment — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable Active Directory capacity assessment for per-project group-provisioning models — measure real RID consumption, project the pool lifetime, and evaluate the risks that actually matter (token bloat, sprawl, lifecycle) with an AGDLP/RBAC design review. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Prove your AD group-provisioning model scales — before you turn it on

Automated provisioning that creates several Active Directory security groups per project (read/write/privileged) can quietly threaten directory scalability — and teams reach for the wrong worry. This assessment answers the real question: is the proposed group-provisioning model sustainable long-term? It measures true RID-pool consumption and projects its lifetime, then evaluates the risks that actually bite at scale — Kerberos token bloat, group sprawl and lifecycle debt, replication and administrative overhead — and reviews the authorization architecture (AGDLP, RBAC, nesting) against Microsoft best practices, so you approve or redesign with evidence, not guesswork.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Assessment Overview — how RIDs, the RID Master, and the per-domain pool actually work (why deleted objects don't return RIDs), what really drives consumption, and the decision this assessment supports (an architectural go/no-go with conditions).
  • Inputs & Requirements — what you need to run it (AD read access, RID Master health, the provisioning rate and group-per-project count) with how to verify each.
  • Assessment Methodology — measure current RID consumption, project the pool lifetime (app-only and blended-org), evaluate the non-RID risks (token bloat, sprawl/lifecycle, replication/GC, backup, admin), and review the authorization model (AGDLP vs. flatten, RBAC/nesting to bound object growth).
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — RID-pool consumption & RID Master health, project-group growth & orphan report, Kerberos token-size exposure for high-membership principals, AGDLP/nesting validator, and a lifecycle-cleanup preview (safe, read-only by default).
  • Recommendations, Guardrails & a reusable Assessment Report template — conditions-of-approval (lifecycle automation, dedicated OU + naming standard, ownership metadata, RID/token/orphan monitoring), plus Testing/Troubleshooting and field-proven Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

An evidence-based go/no-go on your AD group-provisioning model — RID lifetime projected, the real risks (token bloat, sprawl, lifecycle) assessed, and a scalable design confirmed — with a reusable report and scripts you keep.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • RIDCAP-Discovery.ps1 — Report RID-pool consumption, remaining capacity, and RID Master health
    • RIDCAP-LifecycleCleanup.ps1 — Preview the disable/stage/delete of orphaned project groups
    • RIDCAP-Report.ps1 — Project-group growth & orphan report plus a projected RID lifetime
    • RIDCAP-TokenExposure.ps1 — Kerberos token-size / group-SID-count exposure for busy principals
    • RIDCAP-Validation.ps1 — Validate the group-provisioning guardrails against Active Directory

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
